title: #387 Balance and Media
prompt: Are there practical solutions or guidelines for maintaining a healthy balance with social media?

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first major reason is that people spend too much time online, which takes up many hours and prevents them from having time for hobbies or family time.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first major reason is that people spend too much time online, which takes up many hours and prevents them from having time for hobbies or family time.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: One effective solution is to set clear time limits for social media use, which helps people focus on real-life activities during the day.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: One effective solution is to set clear time limits for social media use, which helps people focus on real-life activities during the day.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main problem is the negative impact of comparison and excessive use on mental health.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main problem is the negative impact of comparison and excessive use on mental health.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution is setting clear time limits to improve real-life engagement and well-being.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution is setting clear time limits to improve real-life engagement and well-being.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first major reason for poor digital habits is the inherent design of social media platforms, which is engineered to maximize user attention and time spent scrolling, leading individuals to neglect real-world responsibilities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first major reason for poor digital habits is the inherent design of social media platforms, which is engineered to maximize user attention and time spent scrolling, leading individuals to neglect real-world responsibilities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: An effective solution is promoting digital literacy and self-regulation, empowering users to take control of their feed by setting specific time limits and developing stronger self-control.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: An effective solution is promoting digital literacy and self-regulation, empowering users to take control of their feed by setting specific time limits and developing stronger self-control.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
